messages.subject: S2 fix round done
messages.body: Fixed F1-F6 TDD (red first, 8 new/changed tests failed before the fix): markers are now matched fence-aware via a shared fence scanner, exactly one pair outside fences is legal (otherwise ValueError, exit 2, nothing written, also under --check), --stdout prints the full updated document, and --check with --stdout is an argparse error. Added guards for lone close marker, # T newline H1-only, and --stdout on a file with markers. Result: python3 -m unittest discover -> Ran 69 tests, OK, on branch fleet/build-s2 head a960241d781231af4d1bf30ffba27b9887e363d1 (committed, not pushed, SPEC.md untouched; ruff not installed so lint was not run); known limits left alone.
